lines.say: Meet Jarvis. Your personal AI assistant.
Say, hey Jarvis, or simply type. He listens, thinks, and answers, out loud and in writing.
Ask for music, and it plays. Ask for a trailer, and it's on. Spotify, YouTube, Netflix and more, one request away.
Need something done on your computer? With your permission, Jarvis takes the mouse and keyboard himself.
And you can pause or stop him at any moment.
Ask for a story, an essay, or a summary. He writes it straight into a document, then reworks it when you ask.
Math becomes something you can see. Graph a function, compare two, and find exactly where they meet.
Every equation, solved step by step.
Then zoom out. A living, three D Earth shows the journey between any two places.
Weather. Timers. Your calendar. Pictures made from a sentence, and answers about pictures of your own.
And Jarvis goes where you go. From your phone, send a request to your computer.
Or switch modes, and let the phone handle it by itself.
He can run on a local AI, on your own computer. Phones pair with a one time code. And he asks before taking control.
Jarvis. One assistant. Your computer. Your phone.
